verdict.rationale: Docs show Cursor agents integrate with GitHub, inspect diffs before merge, and 'review PRs in GitHub' (cursor-docs-4, cursor-docs-6, cursor-docs-10), implying some git workflow support, but there is no explicit documentation of the agent autonomously staging changes, writing commit messages, creating branches, or opening pull requests end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs/examples of agent-initiated commit message generation, branch creation, and PR opening, plus independent hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
